CLASSIFICATION.significance: This is the most substantive finding of the session. It is route-level, not model-level: ANY Route D run that uses its full retrieval allowance is GUARANTEED to fail this way, on any model, any provider path, any effort level.

THE_DEFECT.loop_shape: for _ in range(limits['codex']): reserve a codex turn; the turn either returns action.kind=='final' (loop returns) or it retrieves and continues. After the last turn: raise Blocked('CODEX_CALL_CEILING_NO_FINAL_REPORT').
THE_DEFECT.the_arithmetic: 6 codex turns and 6 retrieval slots. Every retrieving turn consumes one codex turn. A model that uses all 6 retrieval slots has consumed all 6 codex turns and has ZERO turns left in which to emit 'final'. A final report is only reachable if the model VOLUNTARILY leaves at least one retrieval slot unused.
THE_DEFECT.the_root_cause: request_payload() tells the model its RETRIEVAL budget ('retrieval_budget': {'web_search': 3, 'web_fetch': 3}) but NEVER tells it the CODEX TURN ceiling. The mechanics string says only 'Return final report when complete'. A rational agent therefore spends its full, explicitly-stated retrieval allowance -- and in doing so guarantees its own failure against an undisclosed turn limit.
minimal_fix_options: Raise limits.codex to at least total_retrieval_slots + 1 (i.e. 7).
Or disclose the turn ceiling in request_payload so the model can reserve a turn for the report.
Either is a BENCHMARK METHOD AMENDMENT and requires operator authority. NOT applied.

WHAT_THE_MODEL_ACTUALLY_DID.strategy: A coherent alternating search/fetch plan, exhausting the stated allowance exactly.
WHAT_THE_MODEL_ACTUALLY_DID.retrieval_ledger: web_search_01..03 and web_fetch_01..03 -- exactly 3 and 3, both ceilings hit precisely, none wasted.
WHAT_THE_MODEL_ACTUALLY_DID.assessment: Six for six, every action schema-valid and validate_action-clean. The model did nothing wrong; it obeyed the only budget it was shown.

RUNTIME_ISOLATION.note: The strongest isolation evidence produced in this program: six consecutive live turns on the API-metered path with zero unapproved native tool events.

ARITY_REPAIR_STATUS.honest_reading: Attempt 3 passed turn 3 because the model did NOT narrate this time, NOT because the repair fired. Narration is nondeterministic (observed once in 3 turns in attempt 1, zero times in 6 turns here). The repair stood as insurance and was never needed. It is still correct and still regression-proven against attempt 1's real turn-3 fixture -- but this run is NOT evidence that it works in production, only that it did no harm.

SPEND.caching: cached_input_tokens = 0 on ALL SIX turns while cache_write ~= input each time. The thread-scoped cache-key inference from attempt 1 is now confirmed across six consecutive turns: every turn paid full input price despite the identical 233 KB acceptance_schema prefix. Roughly 60% of this run's cost was re-sending an unchanged prefix.

evidence: 18 artifacts in W03/ROUTE_D/run/ (request, native and receipt for all 6 turns), plus loop_state/ and broker_state/ ledgers and 6 retrieval captures in evidence/.
